name: spatika
description: Spatika UI — open-source glass React design system and documentation site

scripts.build: npm run build -w @spatika/tokens && npm run build -w @spatika/charts && npm run build -w @spatika/editor && npm run build -w @spatika/react && npm run build -w @spatika/website
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @spatika/charts && npm run build -w @spatika/charts && npm run typecheck -w @spatika/editor && npm run build -w @spatika/editor && npm run typecheck -w @spatika/react && npm run build -w @spatika/react && npm run typecheck -w @spatika/website
scripts.test: npm run test -w @spatika/charts && npm run test -w @spatika/editor && npm run test -w @spatika/react && npm run test -w @spatika/website
scripts.release: npm run build -w @spatika/tokens && npm run build -w @spatika/charts && npm run build -w @spatika/editor && npm run build -w @spatika/react && changeset publish
